rationale: C08 is a direct and material drafting precursor. It states the same employee-management policy, uses several distinctive formulations later incorporated into the child, identifies the substantive issues that became the child's operative framework, and establishes the task force whose requested recommendations evidently led to the later order. C17 and C09 share federal-employment machinery and nondiscrimination concepts, but their operative systems concern equal-employment enforcement rather than employee-organization recognition and collective consultation.

shared_material.child_excerpt: participation of employees in the formulation and implementation of personnel policies affecting them contributes to effective conduct of public business
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The participation of federal employees in the formulation and implementation of employee policies and procedures affecting them contributes to the effective conduct of public business.
shared_material.explanation: This is distinctive near-verbatim policy language.

shared_material.child_excerpt: effective employee-management cooperation in the public service requires a clear statement of the respective rights and obligations of employee organizations and agency management
shared_material.parent_excerpt: We need to improve practices which will assure the rights and obligations of employees, employee organizations and the Executive Branch in pursuing the objective of effective labor-management cooperation in the public service.
shared_material.explanation: The child closely recasts the memorandum's formulation of rights, obligations, and labor-management cooperation.

shared_material.child_excerpt: the term "employee organization" means any lawful association... but such term shall not include any organization... which asserts the right to strike against the Government... or... advocates the overthrow of the constitutional form of Government... or... discriminates... because of race, color, creed or national origin
shared_material.parent_excerpt: management officials will maintain relationships only with those employee organizations which are free of restrictions or practices denying membership because of race, color, religion, or national origin. Further, such officials shall refrain from consultation or relationships with organizations which assert the right to strike against or advocate the overthrow of the government of the United States.
shared_material.explanation: The child converts the memorandum's three organization-disqualification criteria into a formal statutory-style definition.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Agencies shall accord informal, formal or exclusive recognition to employee organizations... [and provides consultation, grievances, appeals, and representation rules]
shared_material.parent_excerpt: This study will cover... definition of appropriate employee organizations, standards for recognition of such organizations, matters upon which employee organizations may be appropriately consulted, and the participation of employees and employee representatives in grievances and appeals.
shared_material.explanation: The memorandum supplies the precise agenda and sequence of core subjects elaborated into the child's recognition and consultation regime.
